title: MDAgents: An Adaptive Collaboration of LLMs for Medical Decision-Making
authors: Yubin Kim; Chanwoo Park; Hyewon Jeong; Yik Siu Chan; Xuhai Xu; Daniel McDuff; Hyeonhoon Lee; Marzyeh Ghassemi; Cynthia Breazeal; Hae Won Park
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 2024
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) is the primary institution;
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: The best way to leverage LLMs for complex medical tasks is unresolved: solo prompting underperforms on hard cases while always using a heavy multi-agent group wastes compute (and can hurt) on easy cases. The paper asks how to automatically match the collaboration structure of a team of LLMs to the complexity of each medical query.
problem_statement.zh: 如何最佳運用 LLM 處理複雜醫療任務仍是未解問題:單一 agent 的 solo prompting 在困難案例上表現不足,而在簡單案例上恆定使用龐大的 multi-agent 群組則浪費運算資源(甚至可能損害效能)。本文探討如何自動使一組 LLM 團隊的協作結構與每則醫療查詢的複雜度相匹配。

key_innovation.en: A prompted "moderator" LLM acts as a zero-shot complexity classifier that labels each query low/moderate/high, and a fixed rule maps that label to one of three collaboration structures — solo Primary Care Clinician, Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT), or Integrated Care Team (ICT) — so the entire team topology is selected per query at inference. Group settings add moderator review and external medical knowledge (MedRAG).
key_innovation.zh: 由一個經 prompt 的「moderator」LLM 充當 zero-shot 複雜度分類器,將每則查詢標記為低、中、高三級,並以固定規則將該標籤對應至三種協作結構之一:單一 Primary Care Clinician、Multi-Disciplinary Team(MDT)或 Integrated Care Team(ICT),使整個團隊拓撲得以於推論階段依查詢逐一選定。群組設定另加入 moderator 審查與外部醫學知識(MedRAG)。

baselines_compared: Zero-shot, Few-shot, Few-shot CoT, CoT-SC, Ensemble Refinement, Medprompt, Majority Voting, Weighted Voting, Borda Count, MedAgents

key_improvements.en: MDAgents achieved best performance on 7 of 10 benchmarks, with a significant improvement of up to 4.2% (p<0.05) over previous methods' best (abstract claim). Per-dataset (MDAgents vs best baseline, v3 Table 2; GPT-4(V) for all except MedVidQA which uses Gemini-Pro(Vision)): MedQA 88.7% vs Few-shot CoT-SC 83.9% (+4.8);
key_improvements.zh: MDAgents 於 10 項 benchmark 中的 7 項取得最佳表現,較先前方法之最佳結果最高提升達 4.2%(p<0.05)(摘要主張)。逐資料集結果(MDAgents 對比最佳 baseline,v3 Table 2;除 MedVidQA 採用 Gemini-Pro(Vision)外,其餘皆為 GPT-4(V)):MedQA 88.7% 對 Few-shot CoT-SC 83.9%(+4.8);DDXPlus 77.9% 對 Few-shot CoT 72.7%(+5.2);SymCat 93.1% 對 Majority Voting 91.9%(+1.2);MedBullets 80.8% 對最佳 baseline 76.0%(+4.8);Path-VQA 65.3% 對 Weighted Voting 62.1%(+3.2);PMC-VQA 56.4% 對 Medprompt 53.4%(+3.0);MIMIC-CXR 55.9% 對 Weighted Voting 53.5%(+2.4)。MDAgents 於 3 項 benchmark 未取得領先:PubMedQA(75.0% 對 Reconcile 79.7%)、JAMA(70.9% 對 Ensemble Refinement 71.0%)與 MedVidQA(56.2% 對 Weighted Voting 57.8%)。消融實驗:自適應複雜度選擇(純文字 81.2%)優於任一固定結構(Low 64.2%、Moderate 71.6%、High 65.8%);結合 moderator 審查與外部知識(MedRAG)帶來 +11.8% 相對提升(71.8% -> 80.3%);準確率於 N=3 個 agent 時達到峰值(83.5%)。

structure_space: Team composition (agent set), Workflow code, Roles / profiles
decision_mechanism: LLM on-the-fly orchestration, Heuristic scoring / ranking
benchmarks_used: MedQA, PubMedQA, DDXPlus, SymCat, MedBullets, JAMA, Path-VQA, PMC-VQA, MIMIC-CXR, MedVidQA

agent_scenario.en: Single medical-domain, LLM-only agents (no external tools beyond an optional MedRAG knowledge retrieval). A moderator agent classifies query complexity; a recruiter assembles specialist roles; depending on complexity the team is 1 agent (Solo), a small MDT (peak accuracy reported at N=3 specialist agents with iterative multi-round discussion and moderator feedback), or a multi-team hierarchical ICT. A final decision-maker aggregates the answer. Roles are prompted personas (Primary Care Clinician, specialists) rather than distinct fine-tuned models.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一醫療領域、僅使用 LLM 的 agent(除選用性的 MedRAG 知識檢索外無外部工具)。一個 moderator agent 分類查詢複雜度;一個 recruiter 組建專科角色;依複雜度不同,團隊為 1 個 agent(Solo)、小型 MDT(在 N=3 個專科 agent 進行多輪迭代討論與 moderator 回饋時報告達到峰值準確率),或多團隊階層式 ICT。最終由一個 decision-maker 彙整答案。各角色為經 prompt 的人物設定(Primary Care Clinician、專科醫師)而非各自獨立 fine-tune 的模型。
